title: A Songbook for the Kitchen
author: Kestrel Villalobos
blurb: Gideon Zhou, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must forgive the person in the mirror first before the festival ends.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
